title: Volcanoes of Papua New Guinea (hot and cold)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Papua New Guinea, one after another. You have three tries for each place and are told warmer or colder after a miss. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.
